# Zscaler Tunnel Overview — ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl. Lineage: `Azure/Azure-Sentinel` commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`, `Solutions/Zscaler Internet Access/Workbooks/NSSTunnelLogs.json`. Vendor-specific values are read from documented `AdditionalFields` keys; select a time range and workspace below.

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSTunnellog'
| extend EventClassId=coalesce(EventOriginalType,tostring(AdditionalFields['EventClassId']))
| where EventClassId =~ 'Tunnel Samples'
| summarize ReceivedBytesSum=sum(todouble(DstBytes)), SentBytesSum=sum(todouble(SrcBytes)) by bin(TimeGenerated,30m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: The bytes received and transmitted in a 60-second sample window by Zscaler from the customer

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSTunnellog'
| extend EventClassId=coalesce(EventOriginalType,tostring(AdditionalFields['EventClassId'])), LocationName=tostring(AdditionalFields['Location'])
| where EventClassId =~ 'Tunnel Samples' and isnotempty(LocationName)
| distinct LocationName
| order by LocationName asc
content.title: List of locations

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSTunnellog'
| extend EventClassId=coalesce(EventOriginalType,tostring(AdditionalFields['EventClassId'])), Activity=coalesce(tostring(AdditionalFields['Action']),DvcAction), Reason=EventResultDetails
| where EventClassId =~ 'Tunnel Event'
| summarize Count=count() by Activity,Reason
| order by Count desc
content.title: Tunnel status events
